Source Crosswalk table: rows 1-7 fill page 4, the single 8th row (ch8 Homecoming) dangles alone atop page 5 leaving ~85% blank. SURVIVES from prior run. Fix: break-inside:avoid on the crosswalk table (keep 8 rows together) or tighten row spacing in book-print.css.

Chapter-final closing pages before a fresh chapter opener (p7->ch1 opener p8, p14->ch3 p15, p25->ch4 p26, p31->ch5 p32, p74->ch8 p75). Normal book pagination; mild, waived. p14 also carries the standalone 'Anatomy of Knowledge' figure, which renders centered and fully legible.

slide-1008 'Emptying the Cup' (Chapter One, wrap-left) bleeds forward onto Chapter Two's opening page and stacks in the left margin with the ch2 'Scale of Incomparability' wrap, pushing the CHAPTER TWO heading + drop cap off-center into the right column. SURVIVES from prior (was ~p9). Mechanism: chapter-open block has no clear:both, so a prior chapter's unresolved wrap float bleeds onto the next chapter's opener. Fix: clear:both on the chapter-open block in book-print.css.

Two same-anchor 40% wrap figures render side-by-side, crushing body text to a one-word-per-line sliver column. p10: slide-1005 'Heavenly Mirror' (left) + slide-1006 'Mutual Subsistence' (right), both anchored ch1 para2. p27: slide-1012 'Forty-Year Syllogism' (left) + slide-1009 'Ledger of the Covenant' (right), both ch4. SURVIVES from prior (was p8/p25). Renderer obeyed align/flow/width; the collision is the auto-layout same-anchor pairing. Re-curate in the Book Composer: separate anchors or make one of each pair standalone.

slide-1014 'The Unbroken Chain of Witnesses' — dense raster placed as a 40% wrap-left; internal diamond-node labels are microscopic / below print readability. SURVIVES from prior (was p85). Better curated as flow:standalone at >=60% width.
